title: Stop UserId and PostId swapping places
summary: Brand the ids with a unique symbol, add type predicates, then win inference back with satisfies.

turns.user: loadFeed had findPost(postId, userId) backwards for months and nothing caught it. i want the types to stop that

assistant.body: Both are aliases for string, so structurally they are one type. Mixing in a brand keyed by a unique symbol makes them distinct by name alone, and the symbol stays unexported so nothing outside this file can forge one.

declare const brand: unique symbol

export type Brand<T, B extends string> = T & { readonly [brand]: B }

export type UserId = Brand<string, 'UserId'>
export type PostId = Brand<string, 'PostId'>

assistant.body: An as cast just switches the checker off at that point, so the narrowing goes at the entrance instead. A function declared value is UserId narrows string to UserId only on the branch where it returned true, which keeps the runtime check and the type in agreement.
